depends_on.name: filenavigator_id
depends_on.documentation: The file navigator this system reads through. REQUIRED in NDI ("mustbenotempty": 1).

depends_on.name: daqreader_id
depends_on.documentation: The reader that decodes this system's files. REQUIRED in NDI ("mustbenotempty": 1).

depends_on.name: daqmetadatareader_id_#
depends_on.documentation: The metadata readers attached to this system. A FAMILY, not a scalar: +ndi/+daq/system.m:495-497 loops with add_dependency_value_n and :48 reads with dependency_value_n. OPTIONAL (NDI's schema says "mustbenotempty": 0, and a system with no metadata reader never enters the loop).

fields.name: ndi_daqsystem_class
fields.documentation: The class name of the DAQ system implementation.
